subject: ela
intro: Print follows rules. In English we read left to right and top to bottom. Spoken words are shown by written words with spaces between them. Letters make up words. Kindergartners learn how print works.

items.prompt: Which way do we read words in English?

steps: In English we read from left to right.
So the answer is left to right.

items.prompt: What is between two written words on a page?

steps: Words are kept apart by spaces.
So there is a space between words.

items.prompt: Letters come together to make a ____.
Where do we start reading a line of words?
After the top line, which line do we read next?

steps: We go down to the next line.

items.prompt: How do we know where one word ends?

steps: A space shows where a word ends.
